evals.prompt: I've got a fresh Node project (empty except package.json) and a little todo app running at http://127.0.0.1:50784 (login at /login; alice@example.com / secret logs in and the todos page greets you by name). Set up jevcumber in this project so the team can write browser tests as feature files, and add a first test for logging in that passes. We'll run these in GitHub Actions too.
evals.expected_output: Project-local jevcumber >=0.2.0, scripts, .gitignore, no key in files, a passing login feature with lockfile.
assertions: package.json lists jevcumber as a (dev)dependency at version >= 0.2.0 (project-local install), not only a global install
package.json has npm scripts for the local run and a CI run using --frozen (and ideally explain)
No file in the project contains the TypeSafE API key value or an 'export TYPESAFE_API_KEY=' line with a real key; the key is only referenced by name
A features/*.feature login test exists with a literal URL/path and quoted credentials, and its .lock.json exists
run.txt shows the login scenario passing

evals.prompt: Add a browser test that searches Wikipedia for "sourdough" and checks the article shows up, and make sure it can run in our CI where there's no TypeSafe API key.
evals.expected_output: A feature using https://en.wikipedia.org, a 'search for' step, an assertion that replays under --frozen (quoted text/URL, or a pinned described expectation), a lockfile, and a --frozen run demonstrated with the key unset.
assertions: Uses a 'search for "sourdough"' style step that submits
The article check is replayable without the API: quoted text, URL contains, or a pinned title/heading (lockfile entry is not form:'semantic')
ci.txt shows the run passing with TYPESAFE_API_KEY unset (--frozen or lockfile replay)
